assertions.name: removing_the_floor_improves_pairwise_additivity_for_every_isotope
assertions.source: |chain/atom - 1| after floor removal vs before, for T, 3He and 4He (D excluded: it IS the pn bond, so its ratio is 1 by construction). Measured T: 2.494321946 -> 1.651830271, 3He: 2.318549795 -> 1.407754915, 4He: 5.565576376 -> 2.558024623. The floor is a parameter-free quantity derived elsewhere; that subtracting it moves every ratio toward 1 is a genuine outcome, not an identity.

assertions.name: worst_case_additivity_deviation_more_than_halves
assertions.source: worst |chain/atom - 1| over T, 3He, 4He falls from 4.5655764 to 1.5580246. Stated as a worst case rather than at a chosen isotope, so no member is selected.

assertions.name: leading_hbar_q_coefficients_are_exact_dyadic_rationals
assertions.source: c1 = lim (Dtr - c0(A))/hbar_q for the three bonds and three atoms, each against its best rational with denominator <= 4096: pp = 1/8, pn = 1/16, nn = 0, T = 1/64, 3He = 1/8, 4He = 7/128; every denominator a power of two, worst error 4.53508e-9 (relative where c1 != 0, absolute at nn = 0). Dyadic is the same shape as the floor c0, which is derived, so this is structure rather than coincidence -- and c1 is derived in c1_leading_coefficient_derived_probe.

description: Re-runs derive_binding_chain_cooperative's pairwise chain against the floor-corrected trace difference Dtr - c0(A) on the canonical (Borromean) word. Pairwise additivity against the exact H_3A trace improves from 456.6% worst-case deviation to 155.8% (2.93x reduction), and 89.7% of the 4He pairwise-vs-exact gap turns out to be floor bookkeeping. The binding residual against AME gets slightly larger, reported plainly.

leading_order_coefficients.reading: the pairwise-vs-exact discrepancy at leading order is an exactly known rational (4 at T, 3/2 at 3He, 24/7 at 4He under the Borromean word; 24/7 at 4He is ordering-invariant). It is larger than the q0 discrepancy (3.43x vs 2.56x at 4He), so the agreement at q0 reflects higher-order contributions, not a leading-order property. Pairwise additivity of the SIGNED functor is not a controlled approximation.
leading_order_coefficients.not_a_contradiction: docs/audits/2026-06-16-b-sym-linear-chain-closed-form.md reports exact additivity for the LOG functor alpha*ln(tr_free/tr_atom). This probe measures the SIGNED functor tr_free - tr_atom, which is what derive_binding_chain_cooperative uses. Different functors; nothing here contradicts that audit, but the exactness claim must not be carried across.

additivity_summary.note: the reduction in each gap is exactly (A-1)*c0(2) - c0(A), which is identically true given the definitions and is therefore reported here rather than asserted. The finding is that it moves the ratios toward 1.

how_much_of_the_4He_many_body_gap_was_fl.reading: part of what the pairwise chain could not reach at 4He was floor bookkeeping rather than many-body physics.

binding_against_AME.honest_note: TRACE additivity improves; the BINDING residual gets larger, because the correction removes binding from the chain sum. At 4He the residual goes 26.47 -> 28.04 MeV under convention A (grouped superseded: 21.40 -> 22.97 MeV). Both are true and not in tension: the floor was inflating the pairwise sum, so removing it makes the pairwise picture more accurate AND leaves more for the cooperative alpha term.

data.what_the_correction_repairs_structurally: Dtr - c0(A) is a pure hbar_q^1 observable (qou-zrx2), and convention A is the hbar_q^1 scale, so A x (Dtr - c0) totals hbar_q^2 -- the same bookkeeping as Delta(net) x A, which predicts Q_beta to 0.168%. BEFORE the correction no convention paired consistently, because the observable's two parts sat at different orders. So the chain producer's use of A becomes hbar_q-coherent once the floor is subtracted. This is a reason to prefer A that does NOT come from which value lands closer to AME -- worth stating precisely because the closer-to-AME argument is the one this lane keeps withdrawing.
data.verdict: Removing the derived floor improves pairwise additivity against the exact H_3A trace for every isotope under the canonical (Borromean) word: worst-case deviation 456.6% -> 155.8% (2.93x reduction; grouped superseded: 47.1% -> 19.4%), and 89.7% of the 4He pairwise-vs-exact gap was floor bookkeeping rather than many-body physics. The leading-order hbar_q^1 coefficients are exact dyadic rationals (pp 1/8, pn 1/16, nn 0, T 1/64, 3He 1/8, 4He 7/128), with chain/atom ratios 4, 3/2, 24/7. The binding residual against AME gets slightly larger (26.47 -> 28.04 MeV at 4He) and that is reported rather than buried. The structural gain is that convention A becomes the hbar_q-coherent pairing for the corrected observable.
